findings: p.42 Dwg 2175-000-05: role label(s) without a berth count: OILER, WIPER - those berths are not counted.
Berths labelled on the GA drawings: 58; total complement in the text: 60 (p.16). Rooms labelled without a berth count (see above) may account for the difference.
Text: 9 single and 22 double staterooms; read from the drawings: 10 single, 24 double - check the OCR result and the drawing.
[46CFR190 § 190.20-35(a)] applies (crew 21 persons (p.38), endurance 60 days (p.47)): "HOSPITAL" is labelled on p.42 (Dwg 2175-000-05, Second Deck). Status: met.

[46CFR190 § 190.20-30(b)] applies (messroom seats 32 persons (p.47), total complement 60 persons (p.16)): the mess room seats 32 of 60 persons at one sitting; confirm how many eat at one time (sittings / watches). Status: review.
